verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents its own CI and headless use. It connects GitHub-hosted runners through ephemeral, authenticated connections, offers ephemeral nodes for containers and CI/CD, and runs in Docker, as a Kubernetes sidecar and via cloud-init on first boot, with an official CLI. A community user also confirms routing a GitHub Actions worker through a tailnet exit node. One user reports that API keys expire after 60 days and need a manual login to renew, which is a limitation for long-running unattended automation but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on unattended auth-key or OAuth provisioning for CI, a fix for the 60-day API key expiry, and evidence beyond one-line doc summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
